references.label: Ministry of Health and Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Bangor Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1950 (1950 c. i)
references.note: Local Act confirming, with amendments, the Bangor Borough (Extension) Order (Northern Ireland) 1949. Royal Assent 10 Jan 1950 (Belfast Gazette issue 1490, 13 Jan 1950, page 9). Appointed day 1 Apr 1950, as printed in the confirmed Order. Bangor borough extended.

references.label: Ministry of Health and Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Newtownards Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1950 (1950 c. ii)
references.note: Local Act confirming the Newtownards Borough (Extension) Order (Northern Ireland) 1949. Royal Assent 14 Feb 1950 (Belfast Gazette issue 1495, 17 Feb 1950, page 41). Appointed day 1 Apr 1950, as printed in the confirmed Order. Newtownards borough extended.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1961: County of Down
references.note: Table 4 ward acreages of Bangor MB (Princetown 633, Ballyholme 564, Castle 601, Dufferin 474, Clifton 151 acres): the 1950 and 1956 additions went to Princetown, Ballyholme and Castle; Dufferin is unchanged since 1926.

references.label: Bangor Borough Council, Proposed Boundary Extension, Map No. 2 (1965) (PRONI VAL/8/283)
references.note: Existing boundary shown as the inner edge of the dark green line; registered on OSNI six-inch County Series Co. Down sheets 1, 2, 5 and 6, Edition 5 (revised 1938, 1939, 1938-39 and 1920 & 1939). approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Bangor borough boundary are taken from the council's 1965 map of the existing boundary or the map of the 1966 Order, registered on the OSNI six-inch Edition 5 sheets (about 20-25 m); parts of the other town and ward lines are traced from the maps deposited with their Orders (about 20-25 m). They are drawn dotted on the map.
